title: K-flat normalized descent of localized extension tensor comparisons to strict coefficient towers
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small Grothendieck site, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $V\in\mathcal C$. Use $R_V=R|_V$ on the localized site $\mathcal C/V$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their ordinary unbounded derived categories with localization functors $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and exact localized-site extension $j_{R!}$ [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Let $S_\bullet=(S_n,s_n:S_{n+1}\to S_n)_{n\geq1}$ be a strict inverse sequence of sheaves of commutative $R$-algebras; all structural maps preserve $R$ and the unit [def-weil-inverse-system]. On the diagram site of [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization], write $\Delta$ for the constant diagram and set
$$\mathcal R_S(M)=\Delta M\otimes^L_{\Delta R}S_\bullet,\qquad
\mathcal R_{S|_V}(K)=\Delta K\otimes^L_{\Delta R_V}(S_\bullet|_V).$$
Derived tensor uses sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and flat-term K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Let $J_R$ be termwise $j_{R!}$ on strict $R_V$-module towers and its exact derived functor. For every $K\in D(R_V)$ there is a unique natural isomorphism
$$\rho_K:\mathcal R_S(j_{R!}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_R\mathcal R_{S|_V}(K)$$
with the following representative normalization. On every flat-term K-flat complex $P$ representing $K$, after the canonical localization comparisons for exact extension and derived tensor, $\rho_{QP}$ is $Q$ of the chain isomorphism of strict towers whose level $n$, degree $i$ map is the inverse sheaf projection comparison
$$j_{R!}P^i\otimes_R S_n\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{R!}(P^i\otimes_{R_V}S_n|_V).$$
These are the tensor comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-extension-tensor]. The isomorphism is natural also in morphisms of the $R$-algebra tower, commutes with all $s_n$ before localization, and is independent of the chosen representative under its canonical derived comparisons. Its evaluation at $n$ is the restriction of scalars of the $S_n$-linear isomorphism
$$(j_{R!}K)\otimes_R^L S_n\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{S_n!}(K\otimes_{R_V}^L S_n|_V),$$
where $j_{S_n!}$ is localized-site extension with coefficient ring $S_n$. On an ordinary module, the comparison carries the extension of the map $p\mapsto p\otimes1$ to that same map after extension. No flatness of $R\to S_n$, no surjectivity of $s_n$, and no boundedness or completion hypothesis is imposed.
